prompt: WebAssembly name section position requirement module
answer:
The WebAssembly name section is a custom section. In the current specification, no specific position in the module is required; custom-section placement errors must not invalidate the module.

An older draft stated that the name section “should” appear only once and after the data section, but the current specification does not include that position requirement.
